name: anim_fin_duo2
subject: a muscular pink paint crocodile monster and a chubby pink paint shark rising out of a paint puddle; a small purple witch hat lies on the puddle between them
desc: Both monsters surge up out of the paint puddle side by side, thick goo stretching off their bodies, turn to each other grinning and slap a big triumphant high five over the soaked hat. Thick sticky paint drips.
